about_the_game:
CAN YOU REACH THE SUN?



Explore the universe in a way never seen before in “Solar Merge”. Diverging from the conventional fruit-based merge games, "Solar Merge" offers an exhilarating journey through the cosmos, where planets are your canvas and the stars your playground.

MERGE AND DISCOVER THE COSMIC ADVENTURE


Each merge unveils a larger and more complex planetary body, challenging you to strategize and think galactically. With stylish graphics optimized for PC, experience the thrill of creating and expanding your own universe.

COSMIC YET INTUITIVE PUZZLE


Progress through levels, each offering a unique cosmic puzzle, set in a rich, visually captivating interstellar environment. "Solar Merge" combines intuitive gameplay with a depth that will keep you engaged for hours. Unlock mysteries of the galaxy, achieve astronomical wonders, and leave your mark in the universe.

Ready to redefine your merge game experience? "Solar Merge" offers an unparalleled blend of strategy, creativity, and interstellar exploration. Download now and start your galactic journey!
